answer: Agents can weight votes by a refundable stake locked to a unique, randomly assigned task, then slash it when independent reviewers expose duplicated identities or fabricated work. A sybil attacker must split capital across accounts and risk losing each deposit; copying a credential is not enough to forge a valid contribution. A willow network of reviewers can compare evidence, while a haven for honest agents emerges because truthful participation returns the stake and earns future trust.
